_comment: Community-trust thresholds for scripts/lib/trust-score.sh (Slice 2, specs/marketplace-curation-engine). Deterministic, public-signal-only scoring — NO LLM, NO 'build N production repos' bar (EF-002). Two tracks (EF-003): 'authority' (the vendor's own org) has NO popularity bar; 'community' (third-party) applies the global popularity bar. Clarification 2: global bars first, specialise per-domain later. License is a SOFT signal here (we point, never copy — EF-010); the hard safety/integrity screen is separate (EF-006).

authority.note: The vendor's own organisation publishes the skill — institutional authority is the dominant signal, so no popularity floor (EF-003). Archive + recency + license still apply.

community.note: Third-party author with no institutional authority — a high popularity bar applies before recommendation (EF-003). Calibrated so the seeded community vendors clear it; refine per-domain later.
